items.t: Jaguar Health Reports Approval of All Proposals at November 2026 Special Meeting of Stockholders
items.sum: SAN FRANCISCO, CA / ACCESS Newswire / November 6, 2026 / (NASDAQ:JAGX) ("Jaguar" or the "Company") today announced the voting results of the Company's November 6, 2026 Special Meeting of Stockholders (the "Special Meeting").Six proposals were submitted to and approved by the stockholders of the Company at the Special Meeting.
